basis: Guidewire’s June 2 release explicitly forecast $218 million to $224 million in total revenue for fiscal Q4 2021, the quarter ending July 31. The $224 million high end was 8.07% below prior-year consolidated revenue of $243,674,000 and below the $231,490,300 cutoff. March guidance had already implied a decline arithmetically, but June 2 was the earliest explicit Q4 total-revenue outlook found.

coverage.detail: September 2, 2020. The prior-year Q4 release established the comparison base. Its forward revenue ranges covered Q1 FY2021 ($162 million to $166 million) and full-year FY2021 ($723 million to $733 million).
December 8, 2020. The Q1 release gave revenue ranges for Q2 ($168 million to $172 million) and FY2021 ($723 million to $733 million). Neither specified Q4 revenue.

March 4, 2021. Guidewire forecast Q3 revenue of $155 million to $159 million and FY2021 revenue of $725 million to $733 million. Using first-half actuals of $349,864,000, the annual high less first-half actuals and the Q3 low implied a Q4 maximum of $228,136,000. This was a calculated residual. Guidewire gave no explicit Q4 total-revenue range in the release.

March 4 management call. The issuer archive dates the call and links the Q2 supplemental data. The CFO discussed removing approximately $4 million of previously expected Q4 billable travel and expenses from the forecast. That figure concerned a component of services revenue and supplied no consolidated Q4 revenue ceiling.

June 2. Exhibit 99.1 explicitly gives the Q4 FY2021 total-revenue range of $218 million to $224 million and lists ARR separately. As a secondary check, the $738 million annual high less nine-month reported revenue of $513,832,000 implies $224,168,000. The explicit quarterly high is $224,000,000.
June 10. The intervening 8-K exhibit announced Rajani Ramanathan’s board appointment and supplied no revenue update.
August 19. Guidewire scheduled Q4 results for September 2 after market close. The notice gave no preliminary revenue figure.
Guidewire’s acquisitions note dates the HazardHub closing to August 18, 2021, after the July 31 quarter end. The acquisition therefore falls outside the reported quarter.

September 2 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations report $229,435,000 and $243,674,000 in total revenue for the three months ended July 31, 2021 and 2020, respectively. Actual revenue exceeded June guidance and still fell 5.84% year over year.

publication_date_evidence: Guidewire’s investor-relations page timestamps the Q3 release June 2, 2021 at 4:15 p.m. EDT. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same June 2 dateline and Q4 outlook.
